name: Holo4D (video reshooting along a new camera path)
summary: NeurIPS 2026 model from Oxford VGG / NTU: reshoots a monocular video along a new camera path. It reconstructs persistent 3D point tracks from the source video and uses them as a scaffold to guide a Wan video diffusion model, so only newly visible regions are generated. 14B and 5B checkpoints, prepared examples, long-video rollout and evaluation tools are released.

publisher.name: Yushi Lan et al. (University of Oxford VGG / NTU)

access.notes: Code and HF checkpoints Apache-2.0; Wan base weights, third-party code and example videos (DAVIS, DROID...) keep their own licenses. A separate '5b-commercial' checkpoint trained on a commercial data mixture is provided.

procedure: git clone https://github.com/NIRVANALAN/Holo4D and create a Python 3.12 conda env
pip install -r requirements/cu130.txt then pip install -e .
Run EXAMPLE=davis_bear bash inference/demo_examples.sh (14B) or MODEL=5b-commercial ... (5B); checkpoints, Wan base and examples download from Hugging Face on first run
Unquantized 14B with dense conditions can exceed 80 GB VRAM (authors sample on one H200)

verdict.why: Real research release with weights and code, clear mechanism (3D tracks as scaffold for a video diffusion prior), useful for previs and camera re-takes; heavy GPU needs and mixed upstream licenses keep it below top score.
